entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I recently purchased. The order number is VF-774-901.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered on December 18th, so that's 19 days ago. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It’s a preference, the device works fine. Now, I know I'm outside the 10-day mark, but I did try to start the return about ten days ago.
Okay, and what happened when you tried to process it then?

Well, there was a pretty bad website error. The whole return portal seemed to be completely down. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I couldn't print the label or get a confirmation number. The entire system seemed to be down that day.
I see. Thank you for that information. Let me just check the official return policy for your VeloBand.
Right, because of the website issue, I'm hoping we can make an exception. Maybe even partial credit if a full refund isn't possible now?
Actually, no negotiation is necessary. I've just pulled up the policy here, and for this item, you're well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? Ninety days? I completely misread that. I was all prepared to show you the screenshot of the site being down.

No need, but I appreciate you being so prepared! Since you're only on day 19, I can process a full refund for you right now. I've just emailed you a pre-paid return label. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it in the mail.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you very much for your help, Alex.
You are very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, the refund will be processed to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist with?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
